name: ALY, the Hon. Dr Anne

headline.note: The official parliamentary biography provides a 2001-16 chronology across Western Australian government agencies and public universities. Contemporary university and government material corroborates the roles, but published evidence does not establish hours, leave, exact intra-year boundaries, or whether overlapping academic and consulting activities were substantive employment. No full-time public or private total is calculated.

career_spells.employer: Department of Education and Training (Western Australia)
career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography records this Western Australian government role in 2001-02. Exact appointment and cessation dates, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Public-sector employment is supported, but substantive full-time status and exact duration are not established.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography records the role from 2002 to 2007; contemporary biographical material independently identifies Aly as a former senior policy officer in the office. Exact transfer date, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Public-sector employment is supported, but a countable full-time interval is not.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography records this 2007-09 position, corroborated by the 2011 WA Women's Hall of Fame biography. Exact appointment/cessation, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: A management title does not prove substantive full-time status; exact boundaries are also absent.

career_spells.role: Postdoctoral research fellow and senior lecturer/researcher
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography places Aly in university teaching from 2009; a 2010 journal biography identifies her as a postdoctoral research fellow at ECU and a 2011 contemporary profile calls her a senior lecturer and researcher there. Published material does not resolve the title transition, contract, hours or leave.
career_spells.counting_note: The work was at a WA public university, but the evidence is insufficient to calculate a full-time interval.

career_spells.employer: Curtin University and Edith Cowan University
career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography combines senior-lecturer appointments at Curtin and ECU from 2011 to 2014. Curtin contemporaneously described Aly as a research fellow in 2011. Employer-specific dates, simultaneous versus successive status, hours and leave are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Both institutions were WA public universities, but overlapping employer attribution and full-time status are insufficiently documented.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official chronology records an associate-professor role in 2014-15; contemporary sources continued to describe Aly as a Curtin research fellow. Exact promotion, appointment, workload and cessation are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Public-university employment is supported, but not a sufficiently bounded full-time interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: ECU's 2015 annual report identifies Aly as one of its first Professorial Research Fellow appointments. Contemporary election coverage described her as an ECU professor in 2016. Exact commencement, campaign leave, workload and cessation are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: A professorial title does not by itself prove substantive full-time status, and the 2016 transition to candidacy and elected office is not precisely evidenced.

career_spells.evidence_note: Biographical and contemporary reporting identify Aly as founder and head of the counter-extremism nonprofit. No paid employment, hours or remuneration are established; the activity overlapped university appointments.
career_spells.counting_note: Nonprofit governance/advocacy is excluded unless substantive paid employment is documented.

career_spells.evidence_note: ABC reporting records Aly's candidacy announcement on 29 January 2016 and election on 2 July 2016. No paid party employment is established.
career_spells.counting_note: Candidate and party activity is excluded.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Cowan
career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography records election for Cowan on 2 July 2016 and subsequent re-elections.

research_notes: Identify Aly's reported part-time English-teaching work while studying, including employer, dates, hours and leave; it is not sufficiently evidenced for a spell here.
Obtain appointment instruments, exact dates, hours and leave for the Department of Education and Training, Office of Multicultural Interests and Equal Opportunity Commission roles.

Disaggregate the official combined Curtin/ECU senior-lecturer entry and reconcile postdoctoral fellow, research fellow, lecturer, associate-professor and professorial-research-fellow titles and overlaps.
Identify the policy-consulting business reported from 2011, its entity, clients, paid activity, hours and overlap with university work.
Establish whether PaVE work or UN/board advisory activity was paid substantive employment rather than governance or professional service.
Obtain 2016 university leave/cessation and campaign arrangements.
